name: Temple Priestess
subtitle: Servant of Ishtar
description: In days of old, temple priestesses of various goddesses wielded surprising authority in Ekur. Their religious and communal education and their authority to conduct certain ceremonies earned the respect and the ear of the populace. Since the Shattering, that learning and those rites have bestowed upon them genuine magical power, which they now use at the behest of their gods.
